description: Elections are a cornerstone of democracy, providing citizens with the power to influence their government and shape their future. However, navigating the complex world of election politics can be daunting. From understanding the electoral process, to recognizing the impact of voter turnout, there are many factors that can influence the outcome of an election. This blog post aims to demystify election politics and equip voters with knowledge.*As pulled from the Tennessee Secretary of State websit
